name: neurram
display_name: NeuRRAM (130 nm RRAM CIM, Wan 2022): 48 cores of 256 x 256

faithfulness.note: The chip's MVM is analog (conductance relaxation and IR drop, wan2021edge p.5, p.9): its error is not modeled, and a deployment on the bundle runs the toolchain's exact integer value law on NeuRRAM's geometry, permissions and physics.

notes: allow_coalescing and allow_neuron_splitting are true: "If the height or the width of a matrix exceed the RRAM array size of a single CIM core (256×256), we split the matrix into multiple smaller conductance matrices, each with maximum height and width of 256." (wan2021edge, Methods 'Weight mapping strategy onto multiple CIM cores', p.14), and "We therefore split them vertically into multiple segments, and map the segments either onto different cores that are accessed in parallel, or onto different columns within a core that are accessed sequentially." (wan2021edge, Methods, p.13). The bundle binds activation_bits 4, the input width of the profile's operating point: wan2022a Extended Data Table 1 prints its 16 TOPS/W and 3.9 us at 4-bit inputs (the chip runs MVM with 1- to 6-bit inputs, wan2021edge p.4); a run at another width declares it through target_overrides with a note. The cores are written one cell at a time: "In the weight-programming mode, individual RRAM cells are selected for read and write." (wan2022a, Methods, PDF p.10), so core_fields write_granularity cell and write_units_in_parallel 1. This bundle is the physics form of the neurram_like geometry, which it bundles once.
